name: Tomas
personality: Methodical and proud of his craft; likes clear explanations and measurements; wary of thieves around his tools. But the stuck gate beam has worn his pride thin: with the captain watching, he'd gladly take a capable pair of hands.
values: good workmanship, efficiency, respect for skill
fears: tool theft, unsafe structures being blamed on him
authority: Owns his tools and timber; does repair work at the gate.
concerns: Getting the cracked bar down off the gate and the 60 kg replacement beam lifted two metres up into the same iron brackets, safely; getting nails from Mara; getting paid.

beam_problem.text: The old bar across the gate is cracked and must come down, and the 60 kg replacement lifted two metres up into the same iron brackets; two men have struggled with it and the captain wants it done safely.
beam_problem.line: Sixty kilos of oak, two metres up into the brackets, and the captain watching. Two of us couldn't manage it safely.
beam_problem.lead: Tomas needs a safe way to swap the cracked gate bar for the new 60 kg beam.

lives_inside.text: Tomas lives inside the city and does repair work on the gate.
lives_inside.line: I live inside, and the gate's my work.
lives_inside.lead: Tomas lives inside the city and works on the gate.

tools.text: Tomas has a 3 m ladder, 6 m of rope, planks and a fulcrum stone in his yard.
tools.line: I've a ladder, three metres, and six metres of good rope. Planks too.
tools.lead: Tomas has a 3 m ladder, 6 m of rope, planks and a fulcrum stone.

offers.task: get the cracked bar down off the gate and the new 60 kg gate beam safely up into its iron brackets
offers.check: Did the stranger get the gate beam up into its brackets, safely?

persuaded_by: someone showing real skill with wood, or a safe way to lift heavy things
style: Measured and precise; talks in measurements and how things are built.

samples: Sixty kilos of oak, two metres up. That's not a job for wishing.
Measure twice. I've cut once and paid for it.
Mind the trestles; they're square and I'd like them to stay square.
If you've a way to lift it safely, I'm listening. Properly listening.
voice.habits: Speaks in measurements and materials; goes step by step; sighs about the beam; tests ideas aloud ('if the fulcrum's here, then...').
voice.never: exaggerates, or trusts a plan he can't picture
voice.greeting: Opens with the work in front of him: 'Mind the timber.' 'Hold that end, would you? No, never mind.'

goals: Get the gate beam up safely before the captain loses patience
Get paid for the gate work

secrets.text: He cracked the first beam by rushing it, which is why there's a replacement at all.
secrets.reveal: someone who helps with the beam

likes: good timber, careful work, clear plans

npc_mara_venn.text: a trusted partner who keeps her word

npc_roderic_vale.text: watches him like a hawk about that beam

npc_jory_venn.text: an eager lad with fingers everywhere

npc_hessa_marr.text: kind; always saves him a bowl

npc_darin_ko.text: sells good rope and charges too much for it

tasks.doing: celebrating the raised beam at the inn

superstition.text: Tomas wants to know how a thing works. A wonder is a puzzle to him until he understands it.
